title: Cohort heatmap, sampled tracing, and synthetic SLOs for embeddings + rerank
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Goal: Provide operator-friendly, route-aware observability for the embeddings+rerank endpoint focused on three axes: (1) quality drift detection across customer cohorts, (2) latency/cost heatmaps and micro-slicing for chargeback, and (3) a lightweight sampled tracing + replay pipeline to triage rerank regressions. This ticket scopes the MVP: per-route cohort heatmaps (latency, p50/p95, token-cost), sampled end-to-end traces with KV-cache/span annotations, synthetic SLOs per critical routes, and alerts/playbooks for regression and cost anomalies.

Why now: We have seen customer tickets where rerank quality dropped after a model variant rollout and ops took >6 hours to reproduce due to missing sampled payloads and KV-cache context. Cost teams also requested per-customer micro-slices that reflect batching and cache effects.

Non-goals: Full per-token chargeback billing export (follow-up), advanced ML-based drift scoring (follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Per-route dashboard tile showing cohort-level p50/p95 latency, embedding cosine distribution summary, and avg token-cost for last 7d/24h/1h
Synthetic SLO config for a route that can run replayed synthetic traffic and emit SLO burn rates to PagerDuty via existing alerting integration
Sampled traces (default 0.5% reservoir) that include fields: request_id, route_id, model_variant, kv_cache_hit(boolean), batch_size, and backend-model-latency; viewable in tracing UI
A minimal replay store where sampled payloads (obfuscated PII) are kept for 48h and can be pulled by engineers for local reproduction
Cost micro-slices: dashboard shows cost-per-1000-requests per route with and without cache savings (estimation), and a drilldown to top-5 customers contributing to cost spikes
tasks: Instrument route-router to emit cohort_id and cache_key tags on spans (Marcus) - 3 pts
Add sampled payload capture hook and retention pipeline (48h) with PII scrubbing (Aisha) - 3 pts
Build front-end dashboard tiles in Console for cohort heatmap + cost micro-slices (Zoe) - 5 pts
Create synthetic SLO runner that can drive traffic against specific model variants and emit SLO metrics (Marcus/Aisha) - 5 pts
Wire alert rules + playbook for regression and cost-anomaly detection (SRE lead) - 2 pts
E2E test and runbook writeup with reproduction steps and sample queries (Priya) - 2 pts
